auth.why: No user accounts or third-party access needed. The user talks to the agent in chat; billing uses the connected Stripe credential only when the user confirms a payout.

description: Turns EU flight delays into money. Detects delayed, cancelled, or overbooked flights, checks them against EU Regulation 261/2004, and drafts the claim letter — €250/€400/€600. Contingency: 30% of the confirmed payout, charged only if the airline pays.

proactive_triggers.description: Delay/cancellation email in Gmail, or boarding pass plus a schedule-change notice

tools.description: Check a flight disruption against EU261/2004 and get the eligibility verdict + compensation amount
tools.name: check_eligibility

tools.description: Get the stored eligibility verdict, tier, and amount for a claim
tools.name: get_claim

tools.description: Generate the Regulation 261/2004 claim letter pack PDF (only for eligible claims)
tools.name: generate_claim_pack

tools.description: Set up billing: create the Stripe customer and card SetupIntent. No charge is made; returns the plain-English 30% fee disclosure first
tools.name: setup_billing

tools.description: Confirm the airline paid out; charge the 30% contingency fee off-session
tools.name: confirm_payout

tools.description: Receive a fanned-out flight_delayed life event; creates a draft claim and returns the proactive nudge
tools.name: handle_life_event

webhooks.flight_delayed: Fired when a qualifying EU261 disruption is detected; agent sends the proactive nudge with the compensation amount.
